summary: Build token classification, custody controls, and crypto risk reporting skills in 5 days. Enroll in Digital Assets, Tokenization and Crypto Risk Training.
lede: Digital asset and tokenization risk training helps professionals assess crypto exposure and make documented oversight decisions. It is designed for people in finance, treasury, compliance, audit, payments, and digital asset operations who need to classify tokens, review custody and on-chain risks, and prepare governance and risk reports using practical templates and control checklists.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already work in finance, treasury, compliance, audit, payments, or digital asset operations and need a practical framework for reviewing tokenization and crypto risk.
prerequisites: You should bring a laptop with internet access and the ability to open public blockchain explorers and spreadsheet templates. Familiarity with treasury, risk, compliance, audit, or digital asset operations will help you complete the exercises effectively. The course uses structured worksheets and sample case materials, so no programming environment is required.
